class: Any test fixture that carries real calendar dates for contracts (expiries) runs against a database whose guards judge 'expired' by the database's own clock: once the wall-clock date passes a fixture expiry, every test step that needs that contract live again (re-listing it after another fixture's forced instrument list delisted it) is refused by the contract-lifecycle guard (ADR-057: a retired contract never changes), and the test fails on a date, not on the code under test. The fixture library silently becomes a time bomb that goes off overnight.
mechanism: tests/fixtures/adjust_scenarios/ADJ-*.json carry fixed expiries (45 of 57 files: earliest expiry 2026-11-03; 8 more 2026-11-09). tests_app/test_adjustment_check.py::_seeded loads each scenario's instrument list with catalogue_store.apply_update(force=True), which delists the previous scenario's contracts; a later test in the same database that needs one of them runs catalogue_store.py:121 `UPDATE ... SET delisted = FALSE, currently_listed = TRUE ... AND delisted AND NOT retired`, which the 0005 lifecycle guard refuses for a contract whose expiry has passed ("contract id 222 (NSE_FO 5000057) has left the market and never changes").

Expiry census: 45x 2026-11-03, 8x 2026-11-09, 1x 2026-11-23, 2x 2026-11-26, 1x 2026-12-29.

fix: Fixed at one choke point (issue #649, GC-MERGE1, 2026-11-08): backend/ofo_app/scenario_mode.py `read` is the one reader of scenario files (scenario_mode.load, Scenario.move_to, scripts/seed_scenario.seed). It moves EVERY date in a file (ISO dates, ISO timestamps, Kite 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' stamps) by one library-wide whole-week offset `date_shift()`: the smallest whole weeks putting the library's earliest expiry (2026-11-03) on or after today + LEAD_DAYS (7), fixed once per process. Whole weeks keep weekdays and every interval, so prices and paise are unchanged. While OFO_SCENARIO is set, backend/ofo/market_calendar.py `world_shift` moves the NSE holidays by the same offset, so before-holiday / next-open answers stay as the fixtures were written (a status-preserving shift without moving the calendar was measured unsatisfiable: the library reaches 2026-12-29 and the calendar has no 2027). Trading symbols (opaque ids) and prose stay as written. Tests' own literal clocks for a scenario add `scenario_mode.date_shift()` / use `scenario_mode.shifted()`.

detection.note: No database. Mutation measured 2026-11-08: with the offset forced to 0 the first check flags 174 library files (expiry before today + 7 days); with the shift it flags 0. The second fails if app code or a script reads a scenario file without `read`. Not covered: a test that reads a fixture file directly with json.loads (tests_app/t19_support.py and test_adjustment_approaches_route.py do, without the DB or the loader, so they need no shift).
